Jenny Z Zhang

Jenny Z Zhang is a Chinese Australian chemist who has made significant contributions to the field of chemistry. Early Life and Education

Jenny Z Zhang was born in China and later moved to Australia, where she pursued her higher education. She earned her undergraduate degree in chemistry from the University of Melbourne, followed by a Ph.D. in chemistry from the same institution. Career

Zhang's academic career is marked by her association with several prestigious institutions, including the University of Cambridge. According to her profile on the University of Melbourne's website, Zhang worked as a postdoctoral research fellow at the University of Cambridge. [1] During her tenure at Cambridge, she was involved in various research projects focused on the development of new materials and their applications. After her stint at Cambridge, Zhang returned to Australia and joined the University of Melbourne as a lecturer in the Department of Chemistry. She has since become a prominent figure in the field of chemistry, known for her work on nanomaterials and their applications in energy storage and conversion. References:
